Summarize Permutation Test Results

Source: R/summary.R
summary.tna_permutation.Rd

Returns the edge-level results of a permutation test as a tidy table. The results for the centrality measures are shown by print().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tna_permutation'
summary(object, digits = 2L, ...)

# S3 method for class 'group_tna_permutation'
summary(object, digits = 2L, ...)

Arguments

object

A tna_permutation or a group_tna_permutation object.

digits

An integer, the number of decimals of diff_true and effect_size. The p-values are not rounded. The default is 2.

...

Ignored.

Value

A data.frame with one row per edge (and per pair of groups, in the first column pair, for a group_tna_permutation object) and the columns from, to, diff_true (the observed difference in the edge weight), effect_size (the difference divided by the standard deviation of the permuted differences, NA when they do not vary), and p_value.

Examples

model <- group_model(engagement_mmm)
# Small number of iterations for CRAN
perm <- permutation_test(model, iter = 20)
summary(perm)
